title: Sound teams, blends and rhymes
titlePs: د غږونو ډلې، یوځای کول او قافیې
intro: Some spellings work as a team for one sound. In a blend, you can still hear both consonants. Compare the writing and listen to the sounds with an adult.
support: ځینې توري یو غږ ښيي. په ګډو بېلو غږونو کې دواړه غږونه اورېدل کېږي. لیکنه وګورئ او له مشر سره غږونه واورئ.
text:
ship · chin · thin · rain · feet · night
brush · sand · clock · sock · rock
model: The sh in ship is one sound. The b and r in brush are two separate sounds. In clock and sock the shared spelling ock helps show the rhyme. Write sh as a pair, keeping the two letters close.
activity: Circle the sound team in night. Ask an adult to model it before you read the word. Draw the sound boxes for brush and mark its first two sounds separately.
adult: Model consonant and vowel teams and the three-letter spelling in night. Listen to the child blend adjacent sounds. Where joined writing is taught, demonstrate an approved join for a familiar pair.
adultPs: د تورو ګډ غږونه وښيئ. ماشوم ته غوږ ونیسئ چې نږدې غږونه سره یو ځای کړي. د ښوونځي د نمونې له مخې د تورو نښلول وښيئ.

rounds.prompt: Build ship from its written sound parts.
rounds.hint: Two letters work together at the start.
rounds.instruction: انګلیسي پوښتنه ولولئ او برخې په ترتیب وټاکئ.

rounds.prompt: Choose the letters that make the sound team in night.
rounds.hint: Look at the middle three letters.
rounds.instruction: انګلیسي پوښتنه ولولئ او برخې په ترتیب وټاکئ.

rounds.prompt: Build the first two sounds of brush.
rounds.instruction: انګلیسي پوښتنه ولولئ او برخې په ترتیب وټاکئ.

tasks: Mark sh in ship and ch in chin. Read both to an adult.
Find the team in thin. Write the word and read it with help.
Circle the teams in rain and feet. Ask an adult to say each word.
Write night, then underline the three letters that work together.
Use an adult's model to write brush and sand from spoken sounds.
Find the part shared by clock, sock and rock. Say another rhyme.
Use your school's handwriting model to practise a join in sh. Tell what sounds you hear at the start of brush.
With an adult, read a new word with sh and a new word with ch. Point to the teams.
Listen to an adult say rain, feet and night. Match each vowel sound to its familiar spelling.
Say two words that rhyme with rock. Write their shared spelling and explain.
